rationale: The reasoner is the empirical and formal contribution; the process reconstruction supports it.
manuscript_action: Reframed abstract and introduction with the system primary and process study secondary.

rationale: Four non-overlapping questions provide a clearer evaluation spine than six overlapping questions.
manuscript_action: Consolidated the questions into coverage, performance, services, and development-process RQs.

rationale: Synthetic lifecycle tests establish interface behavior but not workload-scale utility.
manuscript_action: Changed novelty wording and explicitly limited the incremental evidence to controlled regression experiments.

rationale: The retained evidence establishes a precursor lineage before the standalone repository.
manuscript_action: Added the Moose and Baobab precursor period to the Methods chronology and evidence boundary.

rationale: Conclusions must preserve the populations and epistemic status of the measured results.
manuscript_action: Qualified the performance populations and linked the system and process conclusions to the consolidated RQs.

rationale: A roadmap should match the actual section order.
manuscript_action: Corrected the introduction roadmap.

rationale: Forensic detail is necessary for reproducibility but needs stronger navigation.
manuscript_action: Added explicit evidence-boundary transitions and retained machine-readable detail in the supplement.

rationale: A DOI cannot be truthfully supplied before the final GitHub-to-Zenodo synchronization.
manuscript_action: Kept the archive and DOI as an explicit submission-time action.

rationale: Readers need to know which evidence answers each research question.
manuscript_action: Added an evaluation-to-RQ map and a Methods statement identifying the RQ4 evidence.

rationale: Executed OBO measurements and an unexecuted BioPortal protocol have different evidential status.
manuscript_action: Separated the executed OBO freeze from the preregistered BioPortal extension and stated that it produced no measurements.

rationale: Stateful services are not a continuation of the batch performance experiment.
manuscript_action: Added a transition separating complete batch classification from incremental and explanation validation.

rationale: Commits, sessions, and telemetry counters cannot be treated as equivalent observations.
manuscript_action: Added a chronological three-unit evidence map and prohibited conversion among units.

rationale: Explicit hand-offs improve navigation across architecture layers.
manuscript_action: Added transitions from requirements to architecture, routing to certification, and batch classification to services.

rationale: Topic cues are useful where named case studies and process evidence change level.
manuscript_action: Added corpus strata, hard-case, and process-unit cues while retaining named case headings.

rationale: An opening map makes the threat analysis easier to audit.
manuscript_action: Added a four-part map at the start of Limitations.

rationale: Terminal output and agreement are not equivalent to an adjudicated gold result.
manuscript_action: Rewrote the current-corpus RQ and results to distinguish publication, agreement, splits, and witnessed errors.

rationale: Lean release certification and runtime Rust checks operate at different times and trust boundaries.
manuscript_action: Stated that each classification runs Rust route checks while Lean certifies exact release source and is not invoked per ontology.

rationale: Fresh preprocessing symbols must not leak into the reported taxonomy.
manuscript_action: Stated conservative preservation and evaluation over the original source signature.

rationale: A Boolean decision matrix is not the same object as its positive taxonomy relation.
manuscript_action: Introduced separate matrix and positive-relation notation and handled bottom separately.

rationale: Fail-closed publication does not guarantee that a worker terminates or returns an answer.
manuscript_action: Stated that fallback may timeout, exhaust memory, or decline, in which case no result is published.

rationale: Performance comparisons are meaningful only on named conditioning populations.
manuscript_action: Qualified abstract, results, discussion, and conclusion claims by adjudicated or shared-correct populations.

rationale: The experiment measured end-to-end behavior rather than orchestration alone.
manuscript_action: Removed the overhead inference and explicitly stated that orchestration overhead was not isolated.

rationale: Observable definitions reduce ambiguity across system and process claims.
manuscript_action: Defined certificates, digests, meaningful incrementality, explanation minimization, and telemetry units at first relevant use.

rationale: Stable primary records now identify both direct predecessors without relying on reconstructed metadata.
manuscript_action: Added exact Moose and Baobab titles, authors, arXiv identifiers, and citations to the lineage passage.

rationale: The two telemetry archives need a precise non-overlap convention.
manuscript_action: Specified the half-open platform boundary and prohibited summing incompatible counters.

rationale: The protocol mixed executed and hypothetical procedures in one dense paragraph.
manuscript_action: Split OBO execution, BioPortal sampling, preprocessing, and serialization into separate paragraphs.

rationale: Repeated caveats obscure rather than strengthen the non-additivity constraint.
manuscript_action: Centralized the unit distinction and retained only context-specific qualifications.

rationale: The main result should precede operational recovery detail.
manuscript_action: Kept the aggregate result in Results and confined recovery narration to the source-level adjudication passage.

rationale: Process conclusions should describe evidence rather than advertise it.
manuscript_action: Replaced promotional language with an analytical process account and explicit causal limits.

rationale: Dense compounds slow readers outside the immediate specialty.
manuscript_action: Expanded core terms and simplified abstract and architecture clauses.

rationale: Counts and chronology are easier to scan when separated by evidential role.
manuscript_action: Split route distributions from interpretation and separated phase tables from milestone narration.

rationale: The evidence supports a design choice, not universal transferability or categorical novelty.
manuscript_action: Changed the claim to a testable design choice and removed promotional novelty constructions.

rationale: Cross-disciplinary readers need relationships among the logic, profiles, procedures, and certification claim.
manuscript_action: Introduced OWL 2 DL, SROIQ, EL and EL++, proof-carrying publication, and hypertableau in reader-oriented language.

rationale: Rule vocabulary otherwise assumes specialist familiarity.
manuscript_action: Defined contexts, literals, hyperresolution, factoring, subsumption, blocking, dependencies, clashes, and unravelling.

rationale: A stable glossary can be generated directly from the release route catalogue and option constants.
manuscript_action: Added a fail-closed renderer that maps all 39 public routes to fragments, workers, publication checks, fallbacks, and exact option bundles in TSV and TeX supplements.

rationale: The original notation merged semantically distinct objects.
manuscript_action: Separated the total Boolean matrix, positive taxonomy, bottom queries, and consistency value.

rationale: Readers need to know what state and identity the incremental contract preserves.
manuscript_action: Defined revisions, source digests, retained state, meaningful deltas, migration, and receipt fields.

rationale: Profile and ontology labels need scope at their first substantive use.
manuscript_action: Expanded profile families and named biomedical ontologies and identified overlap among profile counts.

rationale: Infrastructure acronyms and units should not be left implicit.
manuscript_action: Expanded RDF, OSGi, UTC, SWRL, and GiB at first relevant use and described telemetry units.

rationale: One-clause algorithm descriptions are sufficient for the claimed explanation interface.
manuscript_action: Defined deletion minimization, monotone delta debugging, and deterministic hitting-set search.

rationale: The generated glossary now follows the release catalogue and expands common and route-local settings mechanically.
manuscript_action: Added route-glossary generation to the paper checks and documented regeneration.

rationale: The direct research lineage is part of the method and contribution boundary.
manuscript_action: Added Moose and Baobab to the precursor chronology and added source-verified publication citations for both projects.

rationale: The verified R2O2* primary article provides the relevant learned portfolio comparison.
manuscript_action: Added a scoped comparison among learned reasoner ranking, MORe partitioning, and KM's source-feature internal selector.

rationale: Readers need to understand why three procedures appear in one architecture.
manuscript_action: Strengthened the foundational positioning of EL completion, consequence-based saturation, and hypertableau in Background.

rationale: Primary certifying-computation work supports a precise producer/checker comparison.
manuscript_action: Added the certifying-computation citation, explicit residual trust assumptions, and a dimension-by-dimension verification-boundary table.

rationale: Primary incremental-classification and proof-oriented explanation articles were verified.
manuscript_action: Added Cuenca Grau et al. and Evonne, and distinguished KM's regression evidence and source justifications from workload evaluation and proof visualisation.

rationale: The scope requires clearer boundaries around agentic evidence and biomedical evaluation.
manuscript_action: Expanded the process-evidence limitations and separated historical ORE, current OBO, BioPortal protocol, and named hard cases.

rationale: Libraries, editor integration, and baselines occupy different comparison roles.
manuscript_action: Positioned Horned-OWL as frontend infrastructure, Protégé and OWLAPI as interfaces, and reasoners as empirical baselines.

rationale: The certifying-computation source set and comparison dimensions are now explicit.
manuscript_action: Added a synthesis table covering logic scope, verified object, negative-result treatment, and producer boundary.

rationale: The cited Horned-OWL source does not support Turtle parsing.
manuscript_action: Attributed OWL/XML and RDF/XML to Horned-OWL and described Turtle as a separate RDF-parser path.

rationale: OpenHands covers broader agent tasks than bounded issue resolution.
manuscript_action: Distinguished SWE-agent software repair from OpenHands software, browsing, and general-assistance evaluations.

rationale: The Sequoia paper describes an early prototype, so mature was unsupported.
manuscript_action: Replaced the maturity characterization with a supported systems-engineering statement.

rationale: Complete metadata improves bibliographic auditability.
manuscript_action: Added verified issue, editor, publisher, volume, page, DOI, and source-record metadata to the five records.

rationale: Occurrence-level evidence can be generated without weakening the existing key audit.
manuscript_action: Added a renderer binding every citation occurrence to its line, claim context, audited source, and verification status.
